series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 (lesson 8): proportional change, both clauses describing gradual change; につれ written variant.
N3 (lesson 8): meanings together with, at the same time as, as well as; formal register.
N3 (lesson 8): a change continuing in one direction; used with change verbs; formal; related to 一方で.
N3 (lesson 8): a quality already present grows stronger (or weaker).
N3 (lesson 9): stem + かけ for something begun and left unfinished (読みかけ, 食べかけ); verb かける 'about to' sense.
N3 (lesson 9): stem + たて for something just done and still fresh (焼きたて-type combinations).
N3 (lesson 4): nearly happened (but did not); also a ない form.
N3 (lesson 9): approximate span of time or area; mostly written, common in weather reports; mentions にかけては and にわたって.
N3 (lesson 7): again, a second time; more formal than また.
N3 (lesson 8): already; more formal than もう; 'too late' nuance.
N3 (lesson 8): finally, at last, after a long wait or process.
N4 (lesson 2): an action about to start; contrast side for 一方だ.
N4 (lesson 1): gradual step-by-step change; contrast side for ますます.
N4 (lesson 6): completion and unwanted outcome, ちゃう contraction; contrast side for ところだった.
Noun + まで, N5 (lesson 8): exact end point; contrast side for にかけて.
Verb + まで, N5 (lesson 8): checked to confirm the まで level; not used as a target form.
N5 (lesson 5): starting point; printed in the まで items, never the answer.
N4 (lesson 2): everyday 'again'; article-only neighbour of 再び.
N5 (lesson 7): everyday 'already' (also 'more'); article-only neighbour of すでに.
N4 (lesson 2): 'finally' after long effort; article-only neighbour of 遂に.
N4 (lesson 9): just did; article mention only (ところ stages).
N2 (lesson 4): literal 'was just about to'; article mention only, not exercised.
N3 (lesson 8): each time, every time; Verb［る］+ たびに, Noun + の + たびに; contrast side for につれて and と共に (already practised in formal-nouns-time and particle-kiri).
N3 (lesson 3): one-way trend owned by the sibling set degree-excess-addition; article mention only, not targeted here.

supplementarySources.supports: Classification of each new exercise by the construction and the substantive contrast of the complete visible task; basis for labelling the contrast-side items N3.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 4); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: るところだった 'nearly happened' with もう少しで／危うく, against てしまった 'really happened'; the learner builds the form from a supplied base verb. ないところだった and the N2 literal sense (ところだった2) are article-only. Contrast-side てしまった items (Bunpro N4 てしまう) are labelled N3 because each item's base choice is ところだった vs てしまった (jlpt-levels.md lines 368-377); ちゃった accepted.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 7); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Tested as a meaning choice among 再び, すでに and 遂に (again / already / finally). Everyday また／もう一度 are article-only: they are grammatical in the same slots, so register alone would not decide an item.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 8); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Covers 'together with' (person), 'at the same moment as' (event) and 'as well as' (two qualities), against につれて and たびに; each item is decided by meaning (a companion, a single moment or a fixed state; nothing changes and nothing repeats). Where two changes are linked in proportion, と共に is accepted as an additional correct option on the につれて items rather than keyed. Registers (casual, polite, plain written) are mixed across all three keys, and the instruction names the three forms without a tie-break.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 8); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Proportional change between two gradual processes, against たびに (a separate event that repeats); と共に, which can also link two changes, is an additional correct option and an accepted typed answer on these items. につれ and kanji 連れ spellings accepted. Contrast-side たびに items ('every time': a separate event repeats, each time with its own result) separate one continuous change from repeated occasions. たびに is Bunpro N3 (index 164), already covered by formal-nouns-time and particle-kiri, so it has no separate disposition row here; these items were added after blind review so that meaning, not register, decides the につれて items. Displayed buttons are always a pair, never all three: につれて items show につれて／たびに, と共に items show と共に／たびに, and the たびに items alternate (two of each), so every displayed pair is keyed both ways.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 8); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: A quality already present grows stronger, against だんだん (gradually, step by step); an answer-neutral tie-break instruction asks for the form that presupposes the quality was already present. Contrast-side だんだん items (Bunpro N4) are labelled N3 because each item's base choice is ますます vs だんだん (jlpt-levels.md lines 368-377).

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 8); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: One-way continuing trend before printed だ／です, against るところだ (action about to start). ばかりだ is owned by degree-excess-addition and is not targeted here; the article mentions it. Contrast-side るところだ items (Bunpro N4) are labelled N3 because each item's base choice is 一方 vs ところ (jlpt-levels.md lines 368-377).

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 8); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Tested in the three-way formal adverb choice, including 遂に with a negative (遂に完成しなかった). とうとう, やっと and ようやく are article-only neighbours (Bunpro pages for やっと and ようやく returned 404 when checked).

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 8); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Tested in the three-way formal adverb choice, including すでに述べたように. もう is an article-only neighbour (もう also means 'more'; すでに does not).

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 9); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Noun-forming stem + かけ (読みかけ, 書きかけ, 食べかけ) against stem + たて; the learner builds the form from a supplied base verb. Verb かける 'about to / start to' (忘れかけていた) is article-only.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 9); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Approximate span of time or area against exact まで; an answer-neutral tie-break instruction (approximate span) decides sentences where both are grammatical; まで marks precise operational boundaries such as opening hours. にかけては ('when it comes to') and にわたって are article-only. Contrast-side まで items (Bunpro N5 Noun + まで) are labelled N3 because each item's base choice is にかけて vs まで (jlpt-levels.md lines 368-377). The brief's から〜まで became まで with printed から; existing basic-particles items were not duplicated.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (page fetched 2026-11-17, lesson 9); Sensei and SKM not checked by this author
dispositions.note: Stem + たて (焼きたて, 作りたて, 塗りたて, 生まれたて) against stem + かけ. たばかり is article-only as the general 'just did' form.

groups.reason: Introduces につれて against と共に and たびに. たびに is also practised in formal-nouns-time and particle-kiri, but this group introduces it as its own facet, so no form taught only in another group is produced.
Introduces 一方だ against るところだ before a printed だ／です; no form taught only in another group is produced.
Introduces ますます against だんだん as an adverb choice; no form taught only in another group is produced.
Introduces stem + かけ against stem + たて, built from a supplied base verb; no form taught only in another group is produced.
Introduces るところだった against てしまった, built from a supplied base verb; no form taught only in another group is produced.
Introduces にかけて against まで with printed から; no form taught only in another group is produced.
Introduces 再び, すでに and 遂に as a three-way meaning choice; no form taught only in another group is produced.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after reconciliation; no open high or medium findings

findings.claim: すでに could also complete the original 遂に contexts.
findings.change: medicine-completed redesigned to 遂に + negative (十年も研究を続けたが…____完成しなかった); sofa-arrived redesigned so とき places the arrival at the moment of giving up.

findings.claim: The apology-clash argument against 遂に was unsound.
findings.change: Redesigned: sales began at nine and tickets were already sold out by noon (のに); the 遂に rationale argues from the missing long wait.

findings.claim: 遂に could fit a fever rising at night.
findings.change: Added a three-day up-and-down history so tonight's rise is one more repetition, not a long-awaited result.

findings.location: だんだん label and rationales (wanting-to-meet, explanation-confusing, newspaper-reading, sky-darkening, letter-success)
findings.claim: だんだん was described as 'a new state emerges step by step'.
findings.change: Label and rationales now say 'gradually, step by step'; letter-success argues from the set phrase.

findings.claim: The にかけて rationale relied on a rough-span claim that does not hold for clock times in general.
findings.change: Now: にかけて does not mark a precise operational boundary (opening hours, deadlines); use まで for that.

findings.claim: The spelling 段段 was not accepted.
findings.change: 段段 added to the accepted answers.

findings.claim: The redesigned すでに rationale over-claimed a 'no longer + state' requirement.
findings.change: Rationale and explanation now argue that すでに would present the outcome as settled earlier, while the sentence tells of a long effort that never reached its goal (遂に…なかった).

findings.location: all parallel-change items, article §1 and §7, ledger rows 159–160
findings.claim: と共に linking two changes is not limited to formal writing, so the register-based rejection was unsound.
findings.change: と共に is an additional correct option on the four につれて items; a meaning-based たびに contrast was added (new items cake-shop, dentist-advice, town-new-shops, sister-room); no item displays all three buttons; article and ledger rewritten.

findings.claim: 話が進むたびに can describe successive developments within one conversation.
findings.change: First clause changed to 時間がたつ, one continuous process; rationales changed to match.

findings.claim: The instruction carried a tie-break that reserved the slot for につれて.
findings.change: Tie-break removed; superseded by the CPT-A-08 meaning-based redesign.

findings.claim: Register alone cued と共に, and in the three-button set the key was never につれて.
findings.change: Registers of the と共に keys are mixed (graduation-return made casual); displayed buttons are always a pair, so the inventory no longer predicts the key.

findings.claim: An inline example lacked a reading and translation.
findings.change: Converted to a quoted example with kana and English.
